name: Sarasa☆Radical
source:
Her magic brings about love and pleasure ... and disaster?!

A taboo item that turns virgins into succubi had been stolen?! The one looking to retrieve it is the socially inept witch Sarasa! Though unmotivated as fuck, she loves to fuck!

There's only a single method to return those succubified girls back to their original state! You have to *sploosh*♪ cream their wombs with magically enchanted semen!

On top, the girls whom you save get in heat once per day!
You'll be sure to take care of the horny ladies! 

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100125233329/http://www.pixpc.net/marrybell/sarasa_hp/sara_top.htm]Official website[/url]]
translation:
她的魔法带来了爱和快乐……还有灾难？！

将处女变成魅魔的禁忌物品被盗了？！想要取回它的是社交无能的女巫萨拉莎！虽然毫无动力，但她喜欢做爱！

想要让那些被迷惑的女孩们恢复原状，只有一个方法！你必须*喷溅*♪用神奇的精液滋润她们的子宫！

最重要的是，你拯救的女孩每天都会发情一次！
你一定会照顾好色的女士们！
